title: Franklin D. Roosevelt takes office and launches the New Deal
summary: Franklin D. Roosevelt was inaugurated as US president, declaring that the only thing to fear was fear itself, and began a burst of emergency economic legislation.
reason: The Great Depression had left a quarter of workers jobless and the banking system near collapse.
significance: The New Deal reshaped the role of the US federal government in the economy.
place: United States Capitol, Washington, D.C., United States
wikipedia: First inauguration of Franklin D. Roosevelt
